summary: Stage 2 BitumenOps end-to-end testing complete. Backend pytest: 28/28 passing (16 new Stage 2 + 12 existing Stage 1 retained). New tests cover: area PATCH points recompute (4x3 -> 10x5 = 50/30), layer normalization (lowercase 'sma' -> 'SMA'), layer default color (AC_W -> #D9480F, INNE -> #1971C2, SMA -> #E67700), explicit color override, PATCH min 3 points 400, lines POST length=15 for L-shape, line_id format L-MM/YY/0001/0002 with per-project counter, PATCH lines recomputes length, DELETE lines, min 2 points enforced, project DELETE cascade also removes lines. Frontend Playwright: 39/39 assertions pass — all new testids present (tool-edit/tool-line/snap-toggle/export-btn/status-snap), snap toggle button + S hotkey both flip 'Snap: WŁ./WYŁ.', line drawing 3 nodes with live measurement-length-value='15.00 m' / nodes='3', finish-line-btn produces sidebar item with L-06/26/0001 badge, snap-to-grid (gridStep=1) makes 4-corner rectangle = exactly 12.00 m^2, default layer INNE, layer-picker (selected-shape-layer) appears in edit mode after polygon click, layer-option-SMA dropdown changes layer and color to #E67700, all 6 layer-filter-* chips render (ALL/SMA/AC_W/AC_P/BETON/INNE) and correctly filter visible areas, vertex drag persists via PATCH (area_m2 12 -> 13.5), midpoint '+' handle drag inserts new vertex (4 -> 5 pts), Shift+click vertex removes (5 -> 4 pts), export-dialog opens and downloads both '.csv' and '.pdf' files, second line counter increments to L-06/26/0002, area_id format MM/YY/XXXX confirmed. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend layer normalization uses .upper() correctly; unknown layers fall through to LAYER_COLORS.get() with sensible default — solid.
PATCH area/line both correctly recompute area_m2/perimeter_m/length_m on points update and update project.updated_at — race-safe via single update_one.
Atomic line counter via $inc on project doc matches the area pattern — race-safe and deterministic format L-MM/YY/XXXX.
DELETE /api/projects cascades to db.areas + db.lines — both verified empty after delete.
Frontend Workspace.js (~530 lines) is approaching the 700-line guideline limit; consider extracting edit-mode hit-test + pointer handlers into a useEditMode hook for maintainability.
Workspace useEffect for hotkeys uses eslint-disable on deps — function refs (handleDeleteArea/finishArea) referenced inside could go stale; consider useCallback wrap.
ExportDialog filename uses underscores (TEST_Stage2_FE2__obszary.csv) — double underscore from project name concat; cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: Test projects (TEST_Stage2, TEST_Stage2_FE2, TEST_cascade2) auto-created and cleaned up via DELETE API at end of each test/run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests split into two files: test_bitumen_api.py (Stage 1) and test_bitumen_stage2.py (Stage 2). For frontend, the dashboard 'create-project-submit' flow auto-navigates to the workspace immediately on success, so don't expect to find the new card on /dashboard after submit — fetch the project id from the URL or create projects via fetch() in evaluate() like this run. Canvas math: scale=50 px/m at zoom 100%, default offsetX/Y=-10, so world(w) maps to canvas-local px = (w+10)*50. Grid-step dropdown options use role='menuitem' (Radix DropdownMenu); use get_by_text('1 m', exact=True). Layer dropdown options are 'layer-option-SMA', 'layer-option-AC_W', 'layer-option-AC_P', 'layer-option-BETON', 'layer-option-INNE'. Filter chips: 'layer-filter-ALL' + same keys. Export downloads come fast (<3s for CSV, <5s for PDF); use page.expect_download context.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in Stage 2. One test-side adjustment: initial Playwright attempt tried to find newly created project card on the dashboard, but the create-project flow navigates straight to the workspace on success — switched to creating the project via fetch() to make tests deterministic. All 67 combined assertions (28 pytest + 39 playwright) passed.
